findings.title: Long-running transaction
findings.summary: A transaction stayed open for a long time; it holds locks and blocks vacuum.
findings.help: Find it in pg_stat_activity (xact_start) and check for idle-in-transaction sessions or a stuck job; set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout.

findings.title: Rollback share above expected range
findings.summary: A larger share of transactions was rolled back.
findings.help: Check application errors and logs for constraint violations, serialization failures or deadlocks around the episode.

findings.title: Connections vs connection limit at or above 80.0 % (heuristic)
findings.summary: Connections came closer to the database's connection limit; at the limit new ones are refused.
findings.help: Find the clients holding connections, check for leaked or idle-in-transaction sessions, and consider a connection pooler.

findings.title: Server error rate (5xx) at or above 5.0 % (heuristic)
findings.summary: A larger share of requests failed with 5xx server errors.
findings.help: Check application logs and recent deploys for the affected routes, and whether a dependency (database, upstream) failed at the same time.

findings.title: Deadlock detected
findings.summary: Transactions deadlocked and one of them was aborted.
findings.help: Read the database log for the deadlock details and make the involved code paths lock rows in a consistent order.
